gallery.filename: A Rohingya Woman named Mumtaz brutally injured by the Myanmar military.jpg
gallery.title: File:A Rohingya Woman named Mumtaz brutally injured by the Myanmar military.jpg
gallery.source: A Rohingya Woman named Mumtaz brutally injured by the Myanmar military
gallery.description:
Myanmar military brutally murdered, raped and throw ethnic Rohingya people into fires. United Nations human rights chief describe this as ‘textbook example of ethnic cleansing’ and UNs special rapporteur Yanghee Lee describe this as ‘hallmark of genocide’.    
Momotaz describes ‘They continue to kill and made pile the bodies up high. They cut people like bamboo.’ She has seen diffent body part in the pile. The rest of her family were killed in front of her. The horrors Mumtaz experienced didn't stop there, Myanmar military captured her and dragged to a village house and raped. The wooden house was then locked and set on fire. She felt extremely lucky that she was able to come out, but she don’t don't know how she managed to come out. Seven-year-old Razia, who helped her mother Mumtaz to escape from Tula Toli. She suffered head injuries from machete attack during the military operation.
